verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS agent platform like Sierra, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control. The compliance certifications (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2) are adjacent assurances, not a user-facing opt-out mechanism, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
